conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hey, I’ve been charged twice on my credit card for the same transaction! This is ridiculous!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m so sorry to hear that, Sir. Could you please—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: No, seriously, this is the second time something like this has happened! I just checked my statement and—

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I completely understand your frustration. If you could just share the transaction details, I can—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s from last week, some restaurant bill, ₹5,200. I saw it twice, right there, two lines!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you for that info. Let me pull up your account and—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: And don’t tell me it’ll take weeks to fix, okay? I need that money back!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Of course, Sir. It sounds like a duplicate charge; I can initiate a chargeback request right away—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: You better! I can’t keep paying for your mistakes! This is just not acceptable.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Absolutely, I understand. I’ve already flagged this for a refund, and—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: How long is this going to take? I need to know!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It should reflect in 5–7 business days. I’ll keep you updated every step of the way.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Fine. Just make sure it happens this time.
